actors.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
actors.role: Senator of Brazil and defeated presidential candidate
actors.blurb: Following his narrow election defeat to Lula da Silva, Flávio Bolsonaro was ordered by Brazil's Supreme Court to surrender his passport amid a money laundering inquiry. While his Liberal Party (PL) formally recognized the election results, Bolsonaro has challenged the outcome and pledged to lead the national opposition.

actors.name: Marine Le Pen

Polls show her leading early vote intention projections against left-wing and centrist rivals.
